''R6'' - BelowNatural |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = No |moveable = Yes |interactable = No }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Dab on them haters!|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|XD Im so funny|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Dab''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|500}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/51636134/profile AltiWyre]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Dab.gif|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *The [[wp:Dab (dance)|Dab]] was a common dance move, used commonly in the 2010s. *The original store description "''XD Im so funny''" is a satirical remark said by people doing the dance as many people think the '''Dab''' is a cringeworthy dance. **The current store description is another phrase that some people say when doing this dance. *This was one of the first [[emotes]] to be added to the game. *The '''Dab''' emote appears on the emotes tab in the store. ==Update History== *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **'''Dab''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Dab''' is now looped. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. {{EmoteNavBox}}
